what_does_it_do: Establishes a standardized mechanism for NMOS Senders and Receivers to declare support for HDCP over IP streaming using IPMX/HKEP (VSF TR-10-5).
why_does_it_matter: An NMOS Controller can verify that any Receiver is compliant with a Sender producing HDCP-encrypted streams, as only IPMX/HKEP-compliant Receivers can process such content.
A standardized framework enables Controllers to systematically verify and/or enforce compliance.
how_does_it_work: Documents how IPMX/HKEP capabilities are announced by both Senders and Receivers.
Explains how to constrain a Sender’s IPMX/HKEP capability.
Outlines the requirements for Senders, Receivers, and Controllers regarding the IPMX/HKEP feature.
